review.mathCheck: Tangency gives (20m−15)²=100(1+m²), yielding m=(6±√21)/6. Only the minus branch puts G south, giving g=(20√21−75)/3. The contact lies between the endpoints because its x-coordinate is between −10 and 10. Since 21 is squarefree and gcd(3,20,75)=1, the requested sum is 119, choice A.
